name: codex-plugin-claude-agent-team
description: Provider-neutral agent team MCP plugin. Codex (or any MCP host) orchestrates durable multi-agent workflows over a slice DAG with inter-agent mailboxes, isolated write worktrees, and slice-review-before-integration. Adapters cover Claude Code CLI subscription OAuth, codex-cli, gemini, grok, openai-compatible, ollama-cloud, and ollama-claude-code. Use alongside codex-paired-superpowers (v0.10.1+) which contributes the spec/plan workflow + audit gate; this plugin contributes the execution runtime.
